claim_boundary: decision-only re-scoring of retained engine-verdicted executions and the frozen #77 N1 checkpoints; stage d reads post-launch frames and is a diagnostic, not a decision-time ranker; development/exposed N1 members only (held-out = not fit by #77 predictors or controllers, still exposed through earlier tickets); no engine access, rendering or retraining; inventories and cohorts are never pooled; every interval is DESCRIPTIVE; decision-only ranking of retained engine-verdicted executions on the 4 held-out N1 members (never fit here or by #77; exposed through earlier tickets); a new slot encoder and predictors trained on fit lineages of the same two families; no engine access, rendering or capture; no closed-loop or competence claim; every interval is DESCRIPTIVE
disclosure: v2 was frozen after both v1 publications, with every v1 outcome known (all AUCs, contrasts, the Gate A result and the counterfactual token readings written in the v1 record and the #99 comment). The v2 guard definitions come from the diagnoses of the two v1 guard failures and from the parse tolerance the v1 attribution smoke froze before any outcome; no AUC or contrast entered their definition. v2 changes no estimand, cost, threshold, cohort, record or decision rule, and v1 is retained byte-identical (sha256-bound below) under the #87 versioned-protocol practice.

token_rule: each question's v2 token is its frozen v1 rule evaluated with the v2 guard set; a failing v2 guard still forces readiness_or_precision_insufficient

attribution_decision_rule.Q1_attribution: supported iff guards pass AND the dominant drop's lower bound > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass AND the dominant drop's upper bound < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
attribution_decision_rule.Q2_tie_free_cost: supported iff guards pass AND at stage c on mixed grid cells (cohort all) every request's tied-cell share under the tie-free cost is < 0.1; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff guards pass and some request is >= 0.1; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
attribution_decision_rule.baseline_target: reported, not a token: any request at stage c, held-out grid, tie-free cost with AUC >= 0.65 and lower bound > 0.55; the issue's target token is decided after step 3

attribution_guards.G1: stage-c count cost reproduces every #96 record of the 14 requests within 0.001 (same nonfinite exclusions)
attribution_guards.G2: every executed shot's position-0 agent frame is byte-identical to the member's sealed anchor
attribution_guards.G3: engine-projected position-0 carriers agree across a member's shots within 1e-06
attribution_guards.G4: verdict resolution 1.0 and nonfinite typed-failure share <= 0.1 on mixed grid cells for every stage and request
attribution_guards.caps: run GPU seconds <= 10800.0, run wall seconds <= 21600.0
attribution_guards.failure: any guard failure -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient for Q1 and Q2

fix_decision_rule.Q4_encoder_effect: request-mean paired (E - R0) AUC on held-out grid cells, tie-free cost: supported iff mean >= 0.02 and lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
